task_summary: Resolved adviser decision-making authority block in SubmissionReviewPage where faculty advisers were locked out of decision actions ('You do not have decision-making authority for this project'). Enhanced deriveReviewerRole to defensively resolve object and string IDs with fallback to workspace.project, and refactored canModerate and canTakeDecision to recognize appointed faculty advisers (reviewerRole === 'Adviser', workspace.adviserId === user._id) alongside course instructors. Verified with 5 targeted client tests including positive and negative boundary tests, 0 route mismatches, 60/60 agentic validation checks, pristine workspace guardrails, and full Playwright visual audit across light and dark desktop and mobile viewports showing active and unlocked decision controls.
